name: Default
shortDescription: Native C++ inference server for local audio models with a built-in WebUI for text to speech, voice cloning, speech recognition, separation and music generation, running on CPU.

alerts.message: audio.cpp has no login of its own, so the template puts it behind HTTP basic auth: sign in with AUDIOCPP_USERNAME and AUDIOCPP_PASSWORD from the environment variables. API clients must send the same credentials.
No model ships with the image. Open the Models page after deploying and download a package before using Studio. Gated Hugging Face models also need HF_TOKEN set in the environment variables.
This is the CPU build. Small TTS and ASR models such as Kokoro, PocketTTS or Moonshine run fine; large music and LLM-based models need many GB of RAM and are slow without a GPU.
